integrity: The supplied complete standalone verifier scripts were executed, reproduced the same 32541 all-word states, 32530 mixed-word states and sharp representative length 24, and their fixed-width whole-state digest is recorded in CERTIFICATE.json. Generality beyond the specified vocabulary and depth is not claimed.
scientific_limitations: The result concerns rank-two ordinary first-order sentences over finite binary words with <, primitive successor and exactly two named letter predicates, without endpoint constants. A complete finite-state closure and an all-word transfer lemma support the exact enumeration; independent audit has not been performed. Earlier specialized enumeration could affect priority.
title: Exactly \(32{,}530\) binary rank-two theories with successor
